svg.title: Cerebrolysin: what has actually been tested
svg.desc: Cerebrolysin: what has actually been tested. Prevents death after acute stroke: Cochrane review, 7 trials, 1,773 people: no effect on death. Verdict: No effect. Better recovery after stroke: Largest trial (1,070) neutral; smaller, often company-linked trials positive. Verdict: Mixed. Recovery after brain injury: Two CAPTAIN trials, 185 people pooled; small-to-medium effect. Verdict: Preliminary. Dementia (Alzheimer's, vascular): Short trials; Cochrane rates vascular dementia evidence very low quality. Verdict: Weak. Sharper thinking in healthy people: One 1998 EEG study in 48 men; we found no trial of everyday thinking. Verdict: Not shown. Safety: Cochrane: possible rise in non-fatal serious harms; label warns of seizures. Verdict: Open questions. Approved or compoundable in the US: Maker says not approved for US sale; FDA (2020): not eligible for compounding. Verdict: Neither.
